recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle studio portrait of a young woman sitting on her knees, featuring a vibrant red top against a soft pink textured background, paired with contrasting script and sans-serif typography in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: High-angle perspective creating a youthful, approachable scale
Vibrant red shirt as the primary focal point against a pastel pink field
Diagonal alignment of the subject's tilted head with the top-right text block
Soft, even studio lighting minimizing harsh shadows on the subject and background
coreInvariants: Kneeling pose with hands placed flat on the ground
Two-tier typographic hierarchy in the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame; head tilted toward the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red shirt acts as the central chromatic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the red shirt to the hands, then sweeps up to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and right, filled with a subtle pink grain texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Navy Blue (Skirt and Script Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing contrasts with the high-value, low-saturation pastel background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script paired with geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: Fluid, continuous strokes with exaggerated loops on 'B' and 'S'
Sans-serif: Low-contrast, geometric, all-lowercase with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'B' and 'S' feature decorative swash loops that extend horizontally
The 'y' in the script has a long, sweeping descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for personality and brand; sans-serif for modern, clean readability.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment of text to the right edge

preserve: The contrast between navy script and red sans-serif
The lowercase styling of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, casual energy of the primary display text
Matches the geometric, circular nature of the lowercase subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle studio photograph of a young woman with light brown hair, wearing a bright red short-sleeved shirt and a denim skirt, sitting on her knees on a light pink textured floor. The lighting is soft and even, creating a clean, youthful pop aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large navy blue script title in the top right corner. Below it, add a smaller red geometric sans-serif subtitle in all lowercase with wide letter spacing, prefixed by three dots.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle distinctly high-angle looking down?
Is the background a consistent, textured pastel pink?
Is the subtitle text in all lowercase with wide tracking?
Is the primary text color navy blue and the secondary red?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink background hue
Degree of head tilt in the subject
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific artist name and song title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the navy and red text colors are distinct
Verify the grainy texture is present in the pink areas
Confirm the subject is kneeling with hands on the floor
recipe.reuseFormula: High-angle portrait + Pastel textured background + Vibrant primary color clothing + Right-aligned dual-style typography.
